Faculty Profile

Dr. Ru Shan Shy

International educator in Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture with long-term clinical learning under Professor Ming Qing Zhu and advanced neuroscience training in Taiwan.

Zhu’s Scalp AcupunctureClinical reasoningNeurological rehabilitationDao Yin integrationNeuroscience-informed teaching

Biography

Dr. Ru Shan Shy is a direct disciple of Professor Ming Qing Zhu and an international educator in Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture. Her academic and clinical training includes medicine at China Medical University, graduate study at National Taiwan University, and advanced doctoral-level neuroscience training at the Institute of Neuroscience, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, Taiwan. Her teaching integrates classical Chinese medicine, clinical observation, functional reassessment and neuroscience-informed reasoning.
